study type: Secondary analysis of a prospective cohort study
exposure: Pregnancy weight gain above National Academy of Medicine (NAM) guidelines
Gestational weight gain greater than NAM guidelines (WGGG)
cohort: 1,174 patients undergoing term (≥37 weeks) labor induction with a singleton gestation, intact membranes, and unfavorable cervical examination
finding: Weight gain above NAM guidelines is associated with more than a 50% increased odds of cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: This study found an association between weight gain exceeding National Academy of Medicine guidelines and an increased odds of cesarean delivery.
